title: Chukwa Processes and Data Flow
content:
## Overview

This document describes how Chukwa data is stored in HDFS and the processes that act on it.

## HDFS File System Structure

The general layout of the Chukwa filesystem is as follows.

/chukwa/
archivesProcessing/
dataSinkArchives/
demuxProcessing/
finalArchives/
logs/
postProcess/
repos/
rolling/
temp/

## Raw Log Collection and Aggregation Workflow

**[이미지: Chukwa\_Processes\_and\_Data\_Flow\_0.4.png]**  
```mermaid
graph TD
Agent -->|1. Write| Collector
Collector -->|1.1. Stream| DemuxManager
DemuxManager -->|every 20s| DemuxManager
DemuxManager -->|2.1. Read| mrInput["mrInput/"]
DemuxManager -->|2.2. Read| mrOutput["mrOutput/"]
DemuxManager -->|3.1. Copy  
Warn Removed| PostProcessManager
PostProcessManager -->|4. Reprocess| PostProcessManager
PostProcessManager -->|5. Reprocess| Minotaur
chukwa["chukwa/"] -->|logs/| demuxProcessing["demuxProcessing/"]
demuxProcessing --> mrInput
demuxProcessing --> mrOutput
dataSinkArchives["dataSinkArchives/"] -->|[yyyy/MMdd]/\*| dataSinkDir1["\*.done"]
dataSinkArchives -->|[nError/yyyy/MMdd]/\*| dataSinkDir2["\*.done"]
postProcess["postProcess/demuxOutputDir\_\*/"] -->|[clusterName]/[dataType]/| postProcessDir["[dataType]\_[yyyy/MMdd]\_[HH]\_[mm].txt"]
repos["repos/[clusterName]/[dataType]/"] -->|[yyyy/MMdd]/[HH]/[mm]/| reposDir["[dataType]\_[yyyy/MMdd]\_[HH]\_[mm].txt"]
dataSinkDir1 -.->|1.1. Stream| DemuxManager
dataSinkDir2 -.->|1.1. Stream| DemuxManager
postProcessDir -.->|4. Reprocess| PostProcessManager
reposDir -.->|5. Reprocess| PostProcessManager
```

What data is stored where is best described by stepping through the Chukwa workflow.

1. Collectors write chunks to `logs/*.chukwa` files until a 64MB chunk size is reached or a given time interval has passed.
   * to: `logs/*.chukwa`
2. Collectors close chunks and rename them to `*.done`
   * from: `logs/*.chukwa`
   * to: `logs/*.done`
3. checks for `*.done` files every 20 seconds.
   1. If `*.done` files exist, moves files in place for demux processing:
      * from: `logs/*.done`
      * to: `demuxProcessing/mrInput`
   2. If demux is successful within 3 attempts, archives the completed files:
      * from: `demuxProcessing/mrOutput`
      * to: {{dataSinkArchives/\[yyyyMMdd\]/\\*/\\*.done}}
   3. Otherwise moves the completed files to an error folder:
      * from: `demuxProcessing/mrOutput`
      * to: {{dataSinkArchives/InError/\[yyyyMMdd\]/\\*/\\*.done}}
4. wakes up every few minutes and aggregates, orders and de-dups record files.
   * from: {{postProcess/demuxOutputDir\_\\*/\[clusterName\]/\[dataType\]/\[dataType\]\_\[yyyyMMdd\]\_\[HH\].R.evt}}
   * to: {{repos/\[clusterName\]/\[dataType\]/\[yyyyMMdd\]/\[HH\]/\[mm\]/\[dataType\]\_\[yyyyMMdd\]\_\[HH\]\_\[N\].\[N\].evt}}
5. runs M/R jobs at 16 past the hour to group 5 minute logs to hourly.
   * from: {{repos/\[clusterName\]/\[dataType\]/\[yyyyMMdd\]/\[HH\]/\[mm\]/\[dataType\]\_\[yyyyMMdd\]\_\[mm\].\[N\].evt}}
   * to: {{temp/hourlyRolling/\[clusterName\]/\[dataType\]/\[yyyyMMdd\]}}
   * to: {{repos/\[clusterName\]/\[dataType\]/\[yyyyMMdd\]/\[HH\]/\[dataType\]\_HourlyDone\_\[yyyyMMdd\]\_\[HH\].\[N\].evt}}
   * leaves: {{repos/\[clusterName\]/\[dataType\]/\[yyyyMMdd\]/\[HH\]/rotateDone/}}
6. runs M/R jobs at 1:30AM to group hourly logs to daily.
   * from: {{repos/\[clusterName\]/\[dataType\]/\[yyyyMMdd\]/\[HH\]/\[dataType\]\_\[yyyyMMdd\]\_\[HH\].\[N\].evt}}
   * to: {{temp/dailyRolling/\[clusterName\]/\[dataType\]/\[yyyyMMdd\]}}
   * to: {{repos/\[clusterName\]/\[dataType\]/\[yyyyMMdd\]/\[dataType\]\_DailyDone\_\[yyyyMMdd\].\[N\].evt}}
   * leaves: {{repos/\[clusterName\]/\[dataType\]/\[yyyyMMdd\]/rotateDone/}}
7. every half hour or so aggregates and removes dataSinkArchives data using M/R.
   * from: {{dataSinkArchives/\[yyyyMMdd\]/\\*/\\*.done}}
   * to: `archivesProcessing/mrInput`
   * to: `archivesProcessing/mrOutput`
   * to: {{finalArchives/\[yyyyMMdd\]/\\*/chukwaArchive-part-\\*}}
     \\

## Log Directories Requiring Cleanup

The following directories will grow over time and will need to be periodically pruned:

* {{finalArchives/\[yyyyMMdd\]/\\*}}
* {{repos/\[clusterName\]/\[dataType\]/\[yyyyMMdd\]/\\*.evt}}
